# Historical ValveSource XSI scripts

These 42 JS, VBS, and SPDL source files are from the `ValveSource` directory
in Steam2 Portal 2 depot `841` version `1`, blob CRC `8f160ceb`. Paths under
that directory are preserved. They are separate from the adjacent
`ValveSourceCodeDrop` source package in `external/portal2_steam2_xsi`.
Compared by relative path with that package, 23 files are absent there and
5 differ; the other 14 are identical. All copied files were verified byte
for byte against the extracted depot. The aggregate SHA-256 of sorted
relative paths, NUL separators, and binary file digests is
`d7c97ebc22cd6946c00485a7d9415a93bb34966ea89d52a33d45b678e9cef94c`.

These are authoring tool references, not Portal 2 gameplay C++ and not part
of the Waf build. The repository's provenance and distribution warning
applies. Source metadata: [Steam2 depot 841](https://femtendo.github.io/steam2-catalog/#depot-841).
